output.title: HTTP challenge role config already set; review security impact
output.content: This feature adds the global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole helm value, which is already present in this environment's values configuration. This value controls RBAC permissions for HTTP-01 ACME challenges. Since this configuration is already set, review its current value to understand your HTTP challenge setup. The change improves security by allowing cert-manager to drop pod creation permissions when HTTP challenges are not required.
